name: Browser Automation Tester
tagline: Test Playwright and Puppeteer scripts instantly in your browser
description: Browser Automation Tester is an online sandbox for testing browser automation scripts. Write Playwright or Puppeteer code, run it against live websites, capture screenshots, extract data, and debug selectors - all without installing anything. Perfect for web scrapers, e2e test writers, and automation developers who need quick iteration.
target_audience: Web scrapers, QA engineers, automation developers, data extractors
features: Live script execution against any URL
Element selector helper with visual picker
Export scripts to Python, JS, or TypeScript
differentiation: Client-side execution (privacy), no signup, instant results
estimated_traffic: Playwright trending, web scraping demand high
